lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters are arranged in a staggered grid; spacing between spot centroids is approximately 2-4 spot-diameters, with density increasing significantly towards the anterior rostrum.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae, creating localized nodes where the primary high-intensity spots are situated.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge runs horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a high-contrast transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to a shadowed, low-luminance gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct gradient transition is visible where large macro-spots on the mid-body diminish into high-density micro-spots on the snout and cephalic region.
